notice: Ground-truth retrieval relevance judgments for Northstar Retail policy search.
methodology: Constructed by cross-referencing policy questions from evaluation_cases.json with the 22 ingested policy chunks in ChromaDB. Includes knowledge queries, multi-step scenarios, edge cases, and an out-of-domain negative query with no relevant documents to test zero-relevance handling.

cases.query: How many days does a customer have to return most physical items, and what date starts the window?
cases.rationale: Specifies 30 calendar days return window starting from recorded delivery date.

cases.query: How long can a standard domestic shipment take after dispatch?
cases.rationale: States standard domestic delivery estimate is 3-7 business days after dispatch.

cases.query: When should a refund appear after it is approved?
cases.rationale: Explains bank posting timeline of 5-10 business days after approval.

cases.query: I received this mouse and want to return it. What can you do?
cases.rationale: Covers return window, resalable condition requirements, and ownership/order verification procedure.
Covers refund processing timeline and checking operational refund status.
Explicitly declares downloadable digital products and final-sale items non-returnable.

cases.query: How do I track my package after dispatch?
cases.rationale: Explains carrier tracking number assignment and tracking link availability.

cases.query: What happens if my package does not arrive after 7 business days?
cases.rationale: Policy for delayed shipments after exceeding the 7 business day delivery estimate.

cases.query: Can I get a refund before returning the item?
cases.rationale: Mandates that a refund may only be initiated after an eligible return is received and inspected.

cases.query: What is your pet policy and can I bring my dog to your store?
cases.rationale: Negative query testing zero-relevance handling; no retail pet policy exists.
